content.text:
You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This specification models the classic cigarette smokers synchronization problem. A dealer repeatedly offers a set of ingredients that is missing exactly one ingredient, and the smoker who has the missing ingredient can smoke; afterward the system returns to a state where the dealer may offer again. The spec uses a simple state-machine model with variables for the smokers' smoking flags and the dealer's current offer, assumes structural constraints on the set of possible offers, defines a basic temporal specification with `Init /\ [][Next]_vars`, adds weak fairness for `Next` in `FairSpec`, and includes an invariant `AtMostOne` asserting that no more than one smoker is smoking at any time.
